offerings.name: Search API
offerings.pricing: Search costs 2 credits per 10 results; credits shared across endpoints; free plan 1,000 credits/month; paid plans 5,000–1,000,000 credits/month; pay-as-you-go in $5 increments
offerings.price_basis: PAYG Hobby extra credits (1,000 credits per $5); other paid plans give 2,000/2,500/5,000 credits per $5
offerings.free_quota: Free plan: 1,000 credits/month (500 searches or 1,000 pages scraped)
offerings.output_type: 结构化搜索结果（web/news/images/tools），可选抓取全文内容
offerings.note: 2 credits/10 results (rounded up); gov category adds no search credits; ZDR enterprise costs 10 credits/10 or 2 credits/10; optional scraping adds per-page costs
